nodes.name: ChartBackendApplication.java
nodes.summary: Spring Boot entry point that starts the TradingView chart backend and enables AppProperties configuration binding.

nodes.name: ChartBackendApplication
nodes.summary: Application class whose main method launches SpringApplication with nested JWT and TradingView property binding enabled.

nodes.name: AppProperties.java
nodes.summary: Binds the app prefix from application.yml: CORS origins, JWT secret/TTLs, and TradingView datafeed flags used by auth and chart config.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring @ConfigurationProperties with nested static Jwt and TradingView classes bound via @NestedConfigurationProperty.

nodes.name: AppProperties
nodes.summary: Typed configuration bean exposing CORS origins plus nested Jwt (secret, access/refresh TTLs) and TradingView datafeed support flags.

nodes.name: AppUserSeedRunner.java
nodes.summary: Boot-time ApplicationRunner that inserts demo and demo2 local users into m_app_user with BCrypt passwords when those usernames are missing.

nodes.name: AppUserSeedRunner
nodes.summary: Seeds customer_no 1 and 2 demo accounts on startup using AppUserRepository.existsByUsername before insert.

nodes.name: seedIfMissing
nodes.summary: Creates an enabled AppUser with a BCrypt hash and current timestamp when the username does not already exist.

nodes.name: AuthController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for POST /api/auth/login, refresh, and logout; delegates JWT and cookie handling to AuthService.

nodes.name: AuthController
nodes.summary: Maps login, refresh, and logout HTTP endpoints onto AuthService while passing the servlet response for Set-Cookie.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Accepts LoginRequest JSON and returns a LoginResponse with a Bearer access token and HttpOnly refresh cookie.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new access token via AuthService.refresh.

nodes.name: logout
nodes.summary: Revokes the refresh token and clears the chart_refresh_token cookie through AuthService.logout.

nodes.name: LoginRequest.java
nodes.summary: JSON body for POST /api/auth/login carrying the demo username and password used to mint a local JWT.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record DTO with OpenAPI @Schema examples.

nodes.name: LoginRequest
nodes.summary: Record of username and password deserialized by AuthController and checked by AuthServiceImpl against m_app_user.

nodes.name: LoginResponse.java
nodes.summary: Successful login payload with Bearer access token, token type, and access/refresh expiry seconds; refresh token stays in a cookie.

nodes.name: LoginResponse
nodes.summary: Record returned from login: accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, and refreshExpiresIn in seconds.

nodes.name: RefreshResponse.java
nodes.summary: Refresh-endpoint body with a new Bearer access token and expiry seconds after cookie rotation.

nodes.name: RefreshResponse
nodes.summary: Record returned from POST /api/auth/refresh containing the rotated access token and expiresIn.

nodes.name: AppUser.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for local demo logins mapped to m_app_user, including BCrypt hash, enabled flag, and tenant customer_no.
nodes.languageNotes: Jakarta Persistence entity with IDENTITY id mapped to table m_app_user.

nodes.name: AppUser
nodes.summary: Persistent user row used by AuthServiceImpl and AppUserSeedRunner; customer_no is the tenant key for layouts and templates.

nodes.name: BadCredentialsAppException.java
nodes.summary: Runtime exception thrown on failed login when the user is missing, disabled, or the BCrypt password does not match.

nodes.name: BadCredentialsAppException
nodes.summary: Mapped by GlobalExceptionHandler to HTTP 401 E_BAD_CREDENTIALS for invalid username or password.

nodes.name: UnauthorizedAppException.java
nodes.summary: Runtime exception for missing or invalid refresh cookies during token rotation, distinct from bad-password login failures.

nodes.name: UnauthorizedAppException
nodes.summary: Thrown by AuthServiceImpl.refresh when the refresh cookie is absent or the Redis session cannot be rotated.

nodes.name: AppUserRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository for m_app_user lookups by username used on login and demo-user seeding.

nodes.name: AppUserRepository
nodes.summary: JpaRepository of AppUser exposing findByUsername and existsByUsername for auth and seed paths.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring Data derived-query interface; no custom implementation class.

nodes.name: AuthCookieSupport.java
nodes.summary: Helpers that set, clear, and read the HttpOnly Lax chart_refresh_token cookie on servlet responses and requests.

nodes.name: AuthCookieSupport
nodes.summary: Builds Set-Cookie headers for the opaque refresh UUID and extracts that cookie value from incoming requests.

nodes.name: readRefreshToken
nodes.summary: Scans request cookies for chart_refresh_token and returns a non-blank value, otherwise empty.

nodes.name: JwtService.java
nodes.summary: Creates and parses HS256 access JWTs using AppProperties.jwt secret and access TTL, embedding username and customer_no.
nodes.languageNotes: JJWT library with HMAC-SHA key derived from the configured secret string.

nodes.name: JwtService
nodes.summary: Local S-01 stand-in that issues 1h access tokens and verifies them into a ChartPrincipal.

nodes.name: createToken
nodes.summary: Builds a signed JWT with subject username, customer_no claim, issued-at, and access expiration.

nodes.name: parseToken
nodes.summary: Verifies signature and claims, then returns a ChartPrincipal; rejects blank subjects.

nodes.name: RefreshTokenSession.java
nodes.summary: In-memory identity parsed from a Redis refresh key (username plus customerNo) used only to mint a new access JWT.

nodes.name: RefreshTokenSession
nodes.summary: Record holding username and customerNo stored against peach:auth:refresh:{uuid} in Redis.

nodes.name: RefreshTokenStore.java
nodes.summary: Redis store for opaque refresh UUIDs: issue, find, revoke, and rotate keys under peach:auth:refresh with JWT refresh TTL.

nodes.name: RefreshTokenStore
nodes.summary: Persists username|customerNo values in Redis StringRedisTemplate and rotates tokens by revoke-then-issue.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Loads a Redis refresh value, splits username and customerNo, and returns a RefreshTokenSession or empty.

nodes.name: rotate
nodes.summary: Looks up the old token, revokes it, and issues a new UUID for the same username and customerNo.

nodes.name: AuthService.java
nodes.summary: Service contract for local username/password login, refresh-cookie rotation, and logout used by AuthController.

nodes.name: AuthService
nodes.summary: Interface declaring login, refresh, and logout; implemented by AuthServiceImpl as a JWT stand-in for Peach S-01.

nodes.name: AuthServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Authenticates against m_app_user with BCrypt, issues HS256 access JWTs, and manages Redis refresh cookies for login, refresh, and logout.

nodes.name: AuthServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Orchestrates AppUserRepository, PasswordEncoder, JwtService, RefreshTokenStore, and AuthCookieSupport for the local auth flow.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Authenticates the user, creates an access JWT, issues a Redis refresh UUID, sets the HttpOnly cookie, and returns LoginResponse.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Reads the refresh cookie, rotates the Redis session, mints a new access JWT, and returns RefreshResponse or UnauthorizedAppException.

nodes.name: authenticate
nodes.summary: Validates non-blank credentials, loads AppUser by username, checks enabled and BCrypt match, then returns the user or throws.
